items.text: A business operations analyst career path involves tracking performance, finding process bottlenecks, building reports and supporting planning, and it can lead to operations manager, strategy or product roles for people who combine data skill with practical understanding of how work flows.
Learn spreadsheets and SQL, map one real process and build a report that shows a delay or cost you reduced or could reduce.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
